inputs.label: Half-Life: Alyx
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Half-Life: Alyx from Steam. qgp copies the hlvr and core folders.

steps.why: The guide has the user grant storage permissions on the first launch.

steps.text: Open Qualyx from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for storage access, allow it. Let it check the game files, then tap Launch in VR. The guide recommends turning on Settings > Experimental > Positional time warp.

notes: The hlvr and core folders are large; the guide gives no free-space figure. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
